scope: Unlisted BHL PWHL research preview; not independently reconciled with official totals.

iceTime.source: Official PWHL published TOI/GP; HockeyTech shifts for PP/PK research
iceTime.method: TOI from merged shift intervals. PP/PK reconstructed from simultaneous skater counts minus extra attacker when goalie absent. Incoherent intervals are excluded; no full-season average unless every player-game is covered.
iceTime.note: All averages are seconds per game; absent/incomplete data stays null. PP/PK research reconstruction cannot yet cover complete seasons and remains null; TOI uses published season average where available, otherwise complete shift totals. Fantasy points are unchanged.
